policy: For Russia-facing factual knowledge, prefer primary Russian official sources. Secondary material may be used only when explicitly marked as secondary and never treated as primary authority.

primary_sources.name: Президент России
scope: historical state documents published by the President's administration

primary_sources.name: Российская государственная историческая библиотека
scope: historical bibliography and digitized historical materials

primary_sources.name: Государственный исторический музей
scope: Russian history museum collections and scholarly materials

historical_method.conflicting_sources: present both claims, identify source and date, do not silently merge them
historical_method.uncertain_or_disputed_history: mark as disputed/uncertain rather than fabricate certainty
historical_method.current_law: must be checked live against official legal publication before being presented as current

knowledge_domains_to_expand: Russian history from ancient Rus to present
history of peoples and regions of Russia
Russian state institutions and constitutional structure
federal and regional law relevant to self-employed people
personal data and information security law
culture, literature, science and education of Russia
major Russian museums, archives and libraries
official terminology and government service workflows
